キー設定は内蔵ビューア選択時のみ有効です。設定 ▸ 表示 でビューアを「内蔵ビュ.en: Key bindings are only available when the built-in viewer is selected. Switch the viewer to “Built-in Viewer” in Settings ▸ View.

各ページの下余白に章ごとのページ番号を出します。本全体の位置は下端の進捗表示で分.en: Shows a per-chapter page number in the bottom margin of each page. The book's overall position is shown in the progress bar at the bottom.

OFF: 別の本を開くと既存のビューアを閉じて1つに保ちます。ON: 別の本は別.en: Off: opening another book closes the existing viewer, keeping just one. On: another book opens in a separate window. Either way, the same book stays in a single window.

ライブラリ内の重複を検出します。完全一致（同一ファイル）と、シリーズ+巻数が一致.en: Detects duplicates in the library. Shows exact matches (identical files) and “possible matches” where the series and volume number agree.
